scope: Real Chromium strict IndexedDB: existing inline checkpoint, incremental pager with legacy JSON CRC catalog (provider CRC capability disabled), incremental pager with binary per-page CRC records, and the same pager with binary logical snapshot chunks. Same minified bundle/engine/catalog/seed for all four. Times include one SQL UPDATE, logical publication and checkpoint completion. One warmup; three timing samples by default; GC outside timers. Natural thresholds unchanged (128 records/4 MiB); snapshot phase forces one logical snapshot before UPDATE. Separate I/O and memory probes. Value submissions estimated as UTF8 JSON with binary fields null plus binary view byte lengths and put/get key JSON. Not physical disk I/O, IDB encoding or service/process memory. CDP sampled peaks may miss synchronous transients. Setup/bootstrap, verification, reopen, ACK/GC and network excluded from operation times and submission counters; setupMs is recorded separately.
